title: ProcessFlow
description: Where the record currently sits in the registry workflow. Returned by the status-lookup endpoint.

current_stage.description: One of SUBMITTED, DRAFT, PENDING_REVIEW, MARKED_COMPLETE, IN_VERIFICATION, VERIFIED, DUPLICATE_REJECTED, IN_REGISTRATION, APPROVED, CERTIFIED. APPROVED is a polling stage only — it is never delivered as a callback.

stages.description: Per-stage detail. stages.certification.is_certified turns true once the certificate has been issued. The vendor documents the certification flag; the full stage map is not documented field by field.
